notes.title: Spring Into Madness Sale: The Test of Insanity
notes.content:
🌸 Spring is here, and so is the chaos! The Test of Insanity is crashing the Steam Spring Sale with a mind-bending discount that’ll make your brain—and wallet—do a double take. If you’ve ever wanted to test your wits against puzzles that laugh in the face of logic, now’s the time to jump in!

Why You Can’t Miss This:  
- Twisted Challenges Await: From math that breaks calculators to word puzzles that twist your tongue, this game’s got it all.  
- Squirrels Included: Because nothing says “spring” like cute, chaos-causing critters.  
- Level 1 Survivor’s Club: Most don’t make it past the first stage—will you?  
- Ridiculous Fun: Inspired by *The Impossible Quiz*, it’s a wild ride of “wait, what?” moments.  

Where to Lose Your Mind:  
- Steam (On Sale Now!): All 50 levels
- Free Taste of Insanity: Try the web game demo on Newgrounds (10 levels)  

The Spring Sale won’t last forever, and neither will your sanity once you start. Grab *The Test of Insanity* at a special price, dive into the madness, and see how far you can get before the squirrels win. Share your meltdowns with #SpringInsanity—let’s go nuts together!

🌟 Act Fast: Snag it now and prove your brain’s got what it takes!
